{{Top}}
[[File:Malaryush-TLC3.jpg|right|250px|thumb|Lady Leia Organa surrounded by Luke Skywalker, Han Solo and several Noghri.]]
'''Lady''' was title of [[Noble/Legends|nobility]]. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was known as "Lady Vader" among the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]], as she and her family were revered figures in their society. The title [[High Lady]] was held by Lady [[Brezwalt III]],<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Lady [[Varin Arabella]], and Lady [[Bathos]].<ref name="LADY">''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]''</ref> Another known Lady is Lady [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]].
